note: Sac River access west of Collins, on a gravel lane from Route W through savanna and woods. Two mapped primitive camping spots: in the trees beside the boat-ramp lot (privy there), and at the end of the lane where a small gravel lot stops at the river at the area's north tip. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites', two mapped primitive camping spots ~120 m apart (one cluster), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy added. Pin is on the north camping point. Waterfront lead (not waterfront -> riverview/riverfront) from the north lot at the river's edge. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Individual Campsites'; map (6/13/2025) shows two Primitive Camping symbols - at the north-tip parking lot and beside the concrete boat ramp/privy lot. GIS layer 27: point 471 (37.88585,-93.74337, the stored pin) on the north gravel lot (lot 403) and point 388 (37.88486,-93.74394) in the woods just NW of the boat-ramp lot (lot 401). Imagery: graded gravel lane ~400 m from the Route W entrance to both lots; the north lot is ~15 m wide x ~60 m long gravel at a dead end (a 23-ft rig fits and can turn, tight); no ford or posted limit. A third lot (402) is at the Route W entrance, ~860 m south (no camping mapped). One cluster, no split.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront) - lead for an upgrade: on the 0.12 m/px leaf-off frame the north camping lot runs to a row of boulders at the top of the bank, ~6-10 m from the Sac River (~60 m wide there); the GIS camping point 471 itself is ~30-35 m back from the water along the lot, with a band of trees on the bank to its west. A rig parked at the lot's north end has open water directly in front over the boulders - riverfront from the lot end, riverview at least; height of the bank can't be read from imagery. The boat-ramp spot (388) is ~20-30 m from the water through trees (no value). Lead only - stored value not changed.
PIN: stored 37.88585,-93.74337 = GIS camping point 471 on the north lot - fine (the two points are 120 m apart).
PHONE: (417) 853-4592 on the area page matches.
